answer_1.quote: We focus on long-form question answering which aims to generate summaries from a set of passages that answer a specific query.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of the summaries... We measure the summary's relevance using ROUGE-L... we quantify the extent to which generated summaries are faithful to their input using textual entailment (ANLI)... we extend AutoAIS ... to automatically measuring the attribution of long-form responses.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human study to assess the attribution quality of our models. Participants were asked ... to verify whether the citations in the generated summaries are correct, classifying each sentence as fully supported (FSupp) by the referenced passages, partially supported (PSupp), unsupported (NSupp), or contradictory (Contra). A total of 108 annotators participated ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators classified each sentence of the generated summary into one of four categories: Fully Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, or Contradictory.
